Resolved every routed OQ as a typed contract: OQ2 nudge callback = additive Telegram a:n:<ref>:<a|s|d> subprefix (~32 bytes, inside the 64-byte callback_data bound, new callbackKindNudge, never colliding with a:c:/a:d:/spec-028) + WhatsApp reply-id carrying the same shape, both resolved through a shared ephemeral process-local NudgeRef registry so no content_key ever reaches a wire; OQ4 WhatChangedRead = bounded, cursor-paged, authorized read over agent_traces + surfacing verdicts + topic lifecycle (left) and a recency read (right), honest populated/quiet/partial/unavailable/unauthorized, restart-safe with NO unread watermark and NO second store; OQ5 CorrelationRailRead = a RAIL_MAX-bounded call of the spec-105 GraphQueryService.Neighborhood(seed,depth=1) under the same GraphReaderAuthorizer, returning GraphNodeV1 rows + GraphReasonResolver reasons + the stable <kind>:<id> seed for the exact /knowledge/graph?...&seed=&focus= deep-link, honest no-related (105 isolated-only) vs unavailable, no parallel graph path, no client cache; OQ6 snooze = Acknowledge(content_key) on the existing SuppressionWindow (act/snooze/dismiss all ack; snooze differs by intent/label/window; MVP reuses suppression_window_hours; no snooze store); OQ7 identity join = suppression already global by content_key on one process-wide controller, join = (transport,transport_user)->auth.Session principal reusing each transport's existing auth mapping, no identity store. Also specified the web action transport (spec-106 authenticated same-origin mutation carrying only {nudgeRef,action}; no bearer in JS, no new bypass, no new surfacing path) and the command-palette routing contract (Facade OutcomeOK+grounded -> answer; CaptureRoute -> spec-074 Idea + StatusSavedAsIdea; failed/refused -> StatusUnavailable/honest refusal, NEVER saved-as-idea; honors the OutcomeOK-only capture gate in facade.go). No files under specs/105, specs/106, specs/072, or specs/078 were modified.
